description: Search current Mercury outboard inventory at Harris Boat Works (Ontario). Filter by horsepower, family (FourStroke, Pro XS, SeaPro, Racing), or stock status. Returns CAD pricing. Excludes Verado. inStock/stockQuantity are the normalized stock signal; availability is the catalog label. candidatePageTruncated warns when more than 500 candidates match: narrow horsepower filters. Decoded fitment needs transom confirmation; specSource flags database rigging presence, and other fields may still be model-code decoded.
name: search_motors
